notes.title: Happy Ducking Birthday: Celebrating a Year of Arcade Adventures!
notes.content:
Marking the first anniversary of D.U.C.K. fills us with pride! It's been 365 days of endless fun and unpredictable adventures since the ducklings became the heroes of their games. We sincerely thank you, our players, for your invaluable support and constructive feedback, which have played a crucial role in bringing about positive changes to the game. Your input mostly inspired the upcoming update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620203/539861e24aef9be2f72e9deda797f11c64097421.gif[/img]

On this exceptionally special day, we are excited to announce that we’re partaking in the Steam Remote Play Together Fest! During this week you have a chance to SAVE 25% on the D.U.C.K. game and even 40% on the Bundle! This offer ends 19 February, 10 AM PT, so don’t miss it! It’s the perfect gift for anyone who appreciates the fun and is ready to dive into the arcades all night long!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620203/448aebcbbfecc4d388ef48073fe3b351cdd89e8e.jpg[/img]

[h3]The other great news is the major update we’re releasing tonight![/h3]

Within this release, we have intensified the challenge in some of your beloved micro-games, introducing new thrills, and streamlined mechanics in the tough ones. This patch is designed to elevate your gaming experience, offering a more immersive and captivating journey through the D.U.C.K. world. Are you ready to take up new challenges?

Seize the moment and join the ducklings in their adventures full of fun! Whether you do or don’t have a company for tonight, we know the best way to spend this evening — immerse yourself in the nostalgic atmosphere of childhood and retro video games. Let your Valentine's adventure begin right now!

notes.title: DUCK's soundtrack and update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today, March 27, the soundtrack for "DUCK" is released. For now, you can purchase it separately, and a bundle "game + soundtrack" will be released a little later. Enjoy amazing retro music while playing the game and beyond!

We also made some changes and fixed bugs. For example, the level with the labyrinth now has increased visibility range.

Play DUCK, listen to good music and see you soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336320/DUCK_Dangerous_Ultimate_Cartridge_Kidnapper_Soundtrack/

notes.title: First big patch!
Knock knock. Who's there? D.U.C.K.!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that “DUCK: Dangerous Ultimate Cartridge Kidnapper” is now available on Steam! 

All five ducklings are waiting for your help, and each of the 100 microgames is charged to make it hot. Will it be easy? No way. Will it be fun? We swear yes. Tons of references, memes, cool achievements and interesting development even after losing (and there will be losses, no doubt), arcade aesthetics and great sound—that's what awaits you!

We also added a lot of new things, for example:
— “Quack-Tournament”: you can get together with friends in the “hot seat” mode and finally find out which of you is the real King of the Hill;
— “Rubber Terror” with a creepy Rubby Duck and a variety of endings that depend only on you and your friends;
— “Endless Game” for those in whom the Spirit of the Warrior lives and who wants to test themselves to the max.

Val's day? Neah! DUCK: Dangerous Ultimate Cartridge Kidnapper Day? Hell yeah!

P.S. The Evil Spirit of Cartridge started a rumor that you can't play the game, and you won't even beat the first boss, but we don't believe it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41620203/5a36c3e427c9b965a13f1c62c037c33fa4cca076.png[/img]

notes.title: Five days to release!
notes.content:
Hello friends! 
Our game is getting ready for release, very soon you will be able to evaluate the work we have done. For now, we recommend you to check out the demo version of our game on Steam and watch the previously recorded stream of the game. Also, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist.
Have a nice day!

notes.title: Demo, fest, and release soon!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
We are happy to announce that our game is almost ready for release, which will take place on February 14. In addition, we made available the demo version, with which we participate in the festival. Try it and tell us about your impressions, it's extremely important for us!  

Thank you and good duck! Oh, good luck!

notes.title: Anniversary of DVP development!
notes.content:

[b]Quack-new DEMO[/b] - bugfixes, first story chapter with a NEW set of microgames and "Game storage" mode!! Try it, we looking forward to FEEDBACK!!! Only the latest iteration will get on Steam later, but for now you can download the demo on itchio, gamejolt and google disk (DVP_v0.5).
